{
  "template": "import os
import pty
import select
import subprocess
import time

master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
proc = None
buffer = b""
try:
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        ["<command>", "<arg>"],
        stdin=slave_fd,
        stdout=slave_fd,
        stderr=slave_fd,
        close_fds=True,
    )
    os.close(slave_fd)
    slave_fd = None

    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        ready, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.25)
        if not ready:
            continue
        chunk = os.read(master_fd, 4096)
        if not chunk:
            raise RuntimeError("CLI exited before the expected prompt")
        buffer += chunk
        if b"<ready text>" in buffer:
            os.write(master_fd, b"help\n")
            break
    else:
        raise TimeoutError("CLI did not reach the expected prompt")

finally:
    if slave_fd is not None:
        os.close(slave_fd)
    if proc is not None:
        if proc.poll() is None:
            proc.terminate()
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill()
            proc.wait()
    os.close(master_fd)
    print(buffer.decode(errors="replace"))
",
